## Summary

The init-launcher APKs that built yesterday wouldn't install on the new Android 14 Go device. Investigation revealed the culprit: a simple shape drawable for the launcher icon, which Android 14 doesn't accept. Modern Android requires adaptive icons (background + foreground vectors + configuration). The fix was straightforward—swap in proper adaptive icon assets and update the manifest pointer. APK installs cleanly now.

## Per-Repo Activity

### init-launcher

Fixed APK installation failure on Android 14 by replacing the shape-drawable launcher icon with adaptive icon assets. Removed the monolithic ic_launcher.xml and added background/foreground vectors plus the mipmap-anydpi-v26 config that tells Android which pieces to assemble into the adaptive icon. Manifest updated to reference the new structure.

# Developer Journal — 2026-08-15

## Summary

botdocs shipped 0.4.0 with refinements across navigation, RAG, and theme stability. Sidebar groups now collapse to the active section, and nav reorganizes by top-level folder—small moves that reduce cognitive load in documentation trees. The RAG layer leveled up with sentence-level snippet extraction, letting the chat engine surface more precise answer excerpts instead of whole-document chunks. Five themes got CSS stability fixes (slate's split-screen positioning, material/modern footer layout), and a customCss config field lets users inject overrides without forking the theme. Model consent disclosure landed to surface AI use transparently. Security patches brought high-severity vulns down. omniMux refreshed its README away from SvelteKit boilerplate.

## Per-Repo Activity

### botdocs

0.4.0 consolidated three waves of work: navigation (sidebar groups collapse to active, nav groups by folder, page arrows walk root-to-root), RAG (sentence-level snippet extraction for more targeted quick answers), and UX polish across all five themes. Added customCss config for user style overrides, fixed theme-default override bug in CLI, resolved chat scroll positioning, patched dependency vulnerabilities, and released a botdocs-config skill to document the customization surface.

### omniMux

README replaced boilerplate with actual project context.
